ContractField.description: Represents a single field definition within a contract.

name.description: The name of the field (should be camelCase)

type.description: The data type of the field

DataType.description: Supported data types for contract fields.

FieldConstraints.description: Field constraints for data validation and integrity.

allowed_values.description: Allowed values for string fields (restricts to a specific set of permitted values)

not_null.description: Whether the field value cannot be null

ref.description: Reference to another contract field in format 'ContractName.fieldName'

unique.description: Whether the field value must be unique across all records

Metadata.description:
Key-value metadata map for storing arbitrary resource metadata.
Keys are strings, values can be any JSON-serializable type.
